order.title: Order details

steps.d: Browse the group posts and choose your favorite item.
Forward the image to my direct WhatsApp: +971 52 686 4330.
If the photo shows several items, tell me exactly which one you want.
Prices are NOT published on the images. They are quoted live, and at that moment I share the conversion to pesos.
If you want to buy, make a minimum deposit of 60% of the total. Without a deposit, nothing is reserved or purchased.
Transfer in MXN, USD, CAD, EUR, or credit card installments. Please indicate your payment method.
Share your receipt along with: the buyer's name, the delivery city, and complete shipping details. If a family member or friend will receive it, share their details too.
I will notify you in the group when your order is ready. You have up to 15 days to pick it up. Shipments go via DHL / Japan Post / Korean Post, and the cost depends on the destination and weight.
Once purchased, there are no cancellations. If the item has already been paid for in-store, there are no changes, cancellations, or refunds for change of mind, size, color, etc.
The remaining balance must be settled before the order is delivered or shipped.

shipping_policy.boxes_note: Important: all boxes, labels, and wrapping will be removed without exception.
shipping_policy.intro: To keep your purchases from Japan organized: here is how accumulation, item storage, and shipping work.

sections.body: You can accumulate your purchases, but once you reach $20,000 MXN, mandatory shipment will be scheduled.
Once you reach $20,000 MXN, your order must be shipped from Japan to the Mexico, USA, or Canada address you provide.
Before shipment, the remaining balance and the shipping cost must be settled. Nothing ships without full payment.
Please send your full name, phone, city, postal code, and exact address to schedule your shipment. If a family member or friend will receive it, share their details too.
Green: $1 to $9,999 MXN. Yellow: $10,000 to $19,999 MXN. Red: $20,000 MXN or more = mandatory shipment. When you reach red, the balance + shipping are settled and the current accumulation is closed.
If you want to keep accumulating purchases, your current shipment must go out first.
